name: Mauled Diver Corpse (Apprentice Azel)
desc:
The Mauled Diver Corpse is an NPC. It is the lifeless body of Apprentice Azel.

The player is able to pocket the Diver's Journal: Apprentice Azel left behind by the corpse.

Azel was an [apprentice diver](faction:the_divers) participating in the expedition to the [Second Layer](location:second_layer) led by [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract), where he would eventually meet his demise. After being betrayed by [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract) he hid in the [Nest Corridor](location:nest_corridor) and wrote his last thoughts in his journal before being mauled to death by bounders.
additional_info: -   In the removed Diver Journal, I, Azel's surname is stated to be Corbet. This tidbit is not present in Diver's Journal: Apprentice Azel.
